worldcombat.skill.attackorder.summary: Beat your wings and call a swarm of underlings that stream out one after another and sting the target. Each sting is settled on its own and rolls its own critical, so more underlings means more chances to find the seam; an underling cut down on the way never lands its sting. The swarm form fields more, frailer underlings; the elite form fields fewer, heavier ones.
worldcombat.skill.attackorder.descriptio: Calls %1$s underlings, each dealing %2$s non-contact damage when it reaches the target, settled independently.
Command range is %1$s blocks; underlings fly at %2$s blocks/tick and launch %3$s ticks apart.
Each underling has %1$s health and stays at most %2$s; one that is killed lands no sting.
worldcombat.skill.attackorder.stance.swa: Swarm form: two more underlings and faster flight, but 0.8x power each and 3 health — more little stings and more critical chances, and easier to wipe out at once.
worldcombat.skill.attackorder.stance.eli: Elite form: 1.25x power each, faster flight and 7 health, at the cost of fewer underlings.
worldcombat.skill.attackorder.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.attackorder.growth.0: From level %1$s each sting rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.attackorder.growth.1: From level %1$s the swarm grows to %2$s and each sting rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.attackorder.use.0: Send a swarm to sting the target one by one
worldcombat.skill.attackorder.use.1: Roll for a critical many times with many small stings
worldcombat.skill.attackorder.use.2: Make the underlings an output the foe can clear
worldcombat.skill.attackorder.preference: On: two more underlings and 1x flight, but 0.8x power each and 3 health — more little stings and more critical chances, and easier to wipe out at once. Off: the elite form, 1.25x power each, faster flight and 7 health, at the cost of fewer underlings.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of calling. Larger values send the swarm out from further away, giving the foe more time to clear it.
On: past 60% of its range it calls first, pinning a distant target down. Off: it orders like an ordinary attack.
